pages.title: Rift Anchor
pages.text: A clamp for tears between universes. Graviton crystals pin the edges of the rift, void lattice keeps the Bulk from closing in, and exotic matter props the gap open just long enough to reach through. It vibrates faintly, as if something on the other side were tugging back.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Every rift I opened closed before I could use it. In the Graviton Condenser I bound a Graviton Crystal to a Void Lattice Shard with Exotic Matter, and the next rift stayed open long enough for me to put my hand through.

Made in $(item)Graviton Condenser$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Multiverse.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Exotic Matter Crystal, Inflaton Field, Multiverse Rift Stabilizer, Multiverse Shard, Void Lattice Shard.
